policy: One reviewed original per owning page; every qualifying body picture must be exclusive across public HTML.

replacements.name: christian-context
replacements.title: Read the teaching in context
replacements.description: An open Bible and handwritten notes invite a close comparison of passages about faith and discipleship. Follow the linked text for the complete scriptural wording.
replacements.alt: A close view of an open Bible, notebook, pen and ceramic cup, with a reader’s hand resting on the page

replacements.name: christian-question
replacements.title: Give the question time
replacements.description: A woman studies beside a window with an open book and notebook, giving one sincere question her full attention. Read the stated beliefs in their own words, then record what you want to understand more fully.
replacements.alt: A woman in a russet sweater holding an open book and writing in a notebook beside a window

replacements.name: christian-care
replacements.title: Let a conversation lead to care
replacements.description: Two women prepare a meal together, turning conversation into a practical act of care while leaving room for different beliefs.
replacements.alt: Two women preparing a vegetable meal and covering a dish in a home kitchen

replacements.name: christian-listening
replacements.title: Listen while discussing belief
replacements.description: The scene shows shared study. Let each person explain what they understand, with the kindness Christ asks of His disciples.
replacements.alt: Three adult friends discussing belief around a table with an open Bible and notebook

replacements.name: jesus-risen-witness
replacements.title: Meet the risen Savior
replacements.description: The scene portrays Christ among the people at Bountiful. Read the account of His invitation to come forward, and notice how each person is invited to witness for themselves.
replacements.alt: Jesus Christ in a charcoal mantle extending an open hand toward an elderly man in a courtyard

replacements.name: jesus-storm-question
replacements.title: Bring fear into the conversation
replacements.description: Jesus listens to a frightened disciple as wind and waves surround their wooden boat. Read the disciples’ urgent question and notice how the Savior responds.
replacements.alt: Jesus Christ wearing a textured sand-gray mantle with a brown woven edge, seated in a wooden boat and listening to a young disciple

replacements.name: divorce-porch-support
replacements.title: Support Through Divorce
replacements.description: The scene shows companionship during divorce. A trusted person can listen without judging the history of a marriage.
replacements.alt: A father speaking with a trusted friend on a quiet balcony

replacements.name: divorce-listen-with-care
replacements.title: Start by listening to the circumstances
replacements.description: The scene shows listening without pressure. Give the person room to describe their circumstances and seek appropriate support.
replacements.alt: Two women having a careful conversation in separate armchairs

replacements.name: divorce-steady-morning
replacements.title: Leave room for a steady next step
replacements.description: The scene shows making room for a manageable reading. Quiet spiritual practice can accompany practical support during change.
replacements.alt: A woman reading quietly on a window seat during a period of change

replacements.name: divorce-practical-help
replacements.title: Offer useful support
replacements.description: The scene shows useful help during change. Ask what would be welcome and offer a manageable act of care.
replacements.alt: Friends helping arrange belongings in a modest apartment

replacements.name: life-after-death-careful-reading
replacements.title: Read the account carefully
replacements.description: An older man pauses over an open book in a quiet garden, giving the account time and careful attention. Distinguish its teaching from questions it does not answer.
replacements.alt: An older man pausing over an open book in a quiet garden

replacements.name: life-after-death-shared-questions
replacements.title: Bring questions to the reading together
replacements.description: The scene shows shared study. Allow each person to notice something in the resurrection account or name a question that remains.
replacements.alt: Three generations discussing a question from a shared reading

replacements.name: life-after-death-remembrance
replacements.title: Hold hope and remembrance together
replacements.description: The scene shows remembrance. Conversation about someone who has died can leave room for both sorrow and hope.
replacements.alt: A grandmother sharing a keepsake and a memory with her grandson

replacements.name: life-after-death-ordinary-kindness
replacements.title: Carry hope into an ordinary kindness
replacements.description: The scene shows ordinary kindness. Consider a practical act of service while studying Paul's invitation to remain steadfast.
replacements.alt: A neighbor helping care for a small herb garden

replacements.name: families-patient-small-task
replacements.title: Practice patient companionship
replacements.description: The scene shows patience in an ordinary family task. Consider how gentleness and sincere care shape everyday relationships.
replacements.alt: A father patiently helping his daughter learn to tie a shoe

replacements.name: families-neighbor-garden
replacements.title: Let care extend beyond your household
replacements.description: The scene shows care beyond the household. Consider a practical act of service that the person receiving it would welcome.
replacements.alt: A parent and teenager helping an older neighbor clear a path

replacements.name: families-shared-responsibility
replacements.title: Read belonging alongside responsibility
replacements.description: The scene shows shared responsibility. Read Romans 12 and consider how care and belonging can shape ordinary work together.
replacements.alt: Siblings sharing a household task and listening to one another
replacements.inline_scripture_caption_review: Exact original caption retained; scripture mention now links in place with contextual reader and official fallback.

replacements.name: families-child-heard
replacements.title: Let someone be heard
replacements.description: The scene shows giving someone room to be heard. Consider how kindness can shape a difficult family conversation.
replacements.alt: A mother listening as her teenage son speaks on the front steps

replacements.name: two-witnesses-observation
replacements.title: Notice before comparing
replacements.description: A woman compares two open books and records careful notes at a library desk. Write what each passage says about grace and discipleship before drawing a conclusion.
replacements.alt: A woman in a mustard sweater comparing two open books and making notes at a library desk

replacements.name: two-witnesses-readers
replacements.title: Listen to what another reader notices
replacements.description: An older woman and a younger man compare open books on a park bench. Let each person name a passage and explain what they noticed before comparing conclusions.
replacements.alt: An older woman and an adult man discussing their open scripture books on a park bench

replacements.name: two-witnesses-charity
replacements.title: Let charity shape the comparison
replacements.description: The scene shows service. Ask how the teaching about charity could shape the way you respond to someone today.
replacements.alt: A man repairing a wooden gate while an older woman holds a box of tools nearby

replacements.name: mormon-nephi-purpose
replacements.title: Follow Nephi’s stated purpose
replacements.description: A reader pauses over an open book, giving Nephi’s witness of Jesus Christ focused attention. Keep the passage open while considering its stated purpose.
replacements.alt: A contemporary reader in a burgundy shirt studying a book on a stone terrace above a green valley

replacements.name: mormon-ponder
replacements.title: Give a passage your attention
replacements.description: A woman pauses beside a quiet lake with an open book in her lap. Read a short passage slowly, consider its setting and record a question before moving on.
replacements.alt: A woman with an open book on her lap pausing to look across a quiet lake

replacements.name: mormon-settle
replacements.title: Give the reading room to settle
replacements.description: The scene shows reading together. Consider the invitation to ponder and pray before continuing.
replacements.alt: A grandmother listening to a teenage boy as they study together on a living-room sofa

replacements.name: mormon-covenant-care
replacements.title: Read a covenant through acts of care
replacements.description: A modern illustration of practical help. Compare this ordinary act with the willingness to bear burdens described in the passage.
replacements.alt: Adults helping load folded blankets and food into a neighbor’s car

replacements.name: god-ordinary-kindness
replacements.title: Respond through an ordinary kindness
replacements.description: The scene shows neighbors offering help. As a personal application, consider how belief in our relationship with God could shape the way you treat someone.
replacements.alt: A woman and an older man using a wheelchair tending herbs together in a community garden

replacements.name: god-worth-person
replacements.title: Consider the worth of people
replacements.description: The scene shows attending to another person's worth. Reflect on how the passage about divine purpose might shape your care for someone.
replacements.alt: A volunteer listening as an older man describes his handmade bowl

replacements.name: god-faith-seed-care
replacements.title: Give growing faith attention
replacements.description: An ordinary seedling offers a visual point of reflection while reading Alma's comparison. Read the full passage before drawing an application.
replacements.alt: Hands tending a small seedling in a greenhouse

replacements.name: look-harmony-setting
replacements.title: Keep the revelation beside its setting
replacements.description: A quiet rural landscape evokes the setting in which revelation was sought and recorded. Keep the historical introduction beside the revelation as you read.
replacements.alt: An interpretive rural lane approaching a modest early nineteenth-century farmhouse

replacements.name: look-honest-question
replacements.title: Let an honest question remain visible
replacements.description: A woman records a question beside an open book at a quiet overlook, allowing uncertainty to remain visible as study continues.
replacements.alt: A woman recording a question beside an open book at a quiet overlook

replacements.name: look-talk-learning
replacements.title: Talk about what you are learning
replacements.description: The scene shows conversation in daily life. Use the invitation to talk of Christ as a starting point for sharing what you noticed.
replacements.alt: A father and adult daughter talking during an ordinary household task

replacements.name: look-do-good-action
replacements.title: Let study lead to something good
replacements.description: The scene shows practical help. Choose one good action that fits another person's needs and your circumstances.
replacements.alt: A neighbor helping repair a small garden gate

replacements.name: prayer-trusted-question
replacements.title: Keep a question open together
replacements.description: The scene shows companionship. A trusted person can listen while you give a question more time.
replacements.alt: Two sisters giving a question time during a quiet journey

replacements.name: prayer-careful-record
replacements.title: Study, ask and keep a careful record
replacements.description: A notebook can help separate your question, what a source says and a possible next step. Read the instruction to study a matter within its original setting.
replacements.alt: A man keeping a notebook beside an open book during a quiet pause

replacements.name: prayer-thoughtful-counsel
replacements.title: Make room for thoughtful conversation
replacements.description: The scene shows talking a decision through. Another person's perspective can help without replacing your own inquiry.
replacements.alt: Two women pausing for a thoughtful conversation beside their bicycles

replacements.name: prayer-private-room
replacements.title: Read the prayer in its setting
replacements.description: The scene shows prayer without performance. Read Jesus's teaching in Matthew 6 with its surrounding verses.
replacements.alt: A man pausing in private prayer beside an open book
replacements.inline_scripture_caption_review: Exact original caption retained; scripture mention now links in place with contextual reader and official fallback.

replacements.name: stand-source-comparison
replacements.title: Keep the source and your notes together
replacements.description: A student compares a source with her own notes in a library, separating what the text says from what still needs investigation.
replacements.alt: A student comparing a source with her own notes in a library

replacements.name: stand-record-context
replacements.title: Give a record its context
replacements.description: Shelved records and a prepared reading table emphasize the care required to preserve evidence and study it in context.
replacements.alt: A conservator examining an old volume in an archive

replacements.name: stand-faithful-service
replacements.title: Choose a faithful next step
replacements.description: The scene shows practical care. An ordinary act of service can be one response to an invitation to do good.
replacements.alt: A man sharing shelter from rain with an older neighbor

replacements.name: conference-message-notes
replacements.title: Keep the source beside your notes
replacements.description: The scene shows thoughtful listening. Open the complete message, follow its references and record the question you want to explore.
replacements.alt: A woman listening to a message with a notebook ready

replacements.name: conference-response-together
replacements.title: Choose one response together
replacements.description: The scene shows shared reflection. Give each person room to choose a thoughtful response to a message.
replacements.alt: Four friends discussing what they noticed in a shared study

replacements.name: conference-return-question
replacements.title: Return with a question
replacements.description: An older woman returns to a complete message with her notes open, ready to notice what has become clearer through continued study.
replacements.alt: An older woman returning to her notes and a complete message

replacements.name: conference-care-followthrough
replacements.title: Let study lead toward care
replacements.description: The scene shows practical service. Consider a welcome act of care as one response to your study.
replacements.alt: A parent and teenager preparing coats for others to use

replacements.name: temple-purpose-reading
replacements.title: Begin with the purpose of worship
replacements.description: Two friends read an open scripture book together on a shaded garden terrace. Their shared study invites attention to the dedicatory prayer’s requests for learning, holiness and help.
replacements.alt: Two friends reading an open scripture book on a shaded garden terrace

replacements.name: temple-preparation-notes
replacements.title: Prepare through learning
replacements.description: The scene shows preparation. Bring a specific question to the dedicatory prayer and read its language about learning, faith and order in context.
replacements.alt: Hands holding an open scripture book beside a closed notebook and folded jacket

replacements.name: temple-daily-promises
replacements.title: Connect worship with daily commitments
replacements.description: A father and adult daughter talk while sharing the work of washing and drying dishes, connecting promises to God with patient care in daily life.
replacements.alt: A father and adult daughter talking while washing and drying dishes

replacements.name: temple-covenant-help
replacements.title: Carry a covenant into daily care
replacements.description: The scene shows neighbors offering practical help. Consider one way to live the willingness to bear burdens described in the passage.
replacements.alt: Two neighbors clearing fallen branches from an older neighbor's garden path

replacements.name: trials-honest-prayer
replacements.title: Bring distress into prayer
replacements.description: A man bows his head at a kitchen table, bringing distress honestly into prayer while hardship continues.
replacements.alt: A man bowing his head in prayer at a kitchen table

replacements.name: trials-help-within
replacements.title: Notice help within difficulty
replacements.description: The scene shows help while a difficulty continues. Read how Alma's people describe support before their circumstances change.
replacements.alt: A woman with a wrapped wrist holding a book while a friend brings water

replacements.name: trials-shared-load
replacements.title: Take one step with support
replacements.description: The scene shows sharing an ordinary burden. As you consider the passage, notice one way to receive or offer practical support.
replacements.alt: Three gardeners sharing the weight of a wooden planter

replacements.name: trials-next-step
replacements.title: Take the next step with support
replacements.description: The scene shows companionship while taking a careful next step. Consider what support you could seek or offer as a difficulty continues.
replacements.alt: A woman using a walking stick beside a companion on a woodland path

replacements.name: joseph-account-reading
replacements.title: Keep the account open
replacements.description: A reader studies a written account closely, modeling the patience required to keep the source’s words distinct from personal interpretation.
replacements.alt: A reader examining a written document beside an open book in an archive

replacements.name: bible-bountiful-witness
replacements.title: Consider the witness at Bountiful
replacements.description: Jesus Christ teaches people gathered at Bountiful, inviting readers to place His words beside the New Testament witness discussed on this page.
replacements.alt: Jesus Christ speaking with an attentive listener

replacements.name: child-loss-father-comfort
replacements.title: Compassion for a grieving father
replacements.description: The Savior sits beside a grieving father with quiet compassion. The surrounding study makes room for sorrow, remembrance and hope.
replacements.alt: Symbolic artwork of Jesus Christ listening beside a grieving father holding a toy airplane

replacements.name: child-loss-listening
replacements.title: Give each person room to speak
replacements.description: The scene shows listening after loss. Family members may express grief differently; patient attention can make room for what each person needs to say.
replacements.alt: Two women making room for a quiet conversation in a garden

replacements.name: child-loss-ordinary-help
replacements.title: Help with the ordinary burdens
replacements.description: The scene shows practical care. Ask which errand or ordinary task would help, and let the family guide your offer.
replacements.alt: A neighbor helping a parent load groceries into a parked car

replacements.name: child-loss-parents-company
replacements.title: Companionship in grief
replacements.description: The Savior’s quiet companionship beside a grieving father reflects compassionate presence without placing a timetable on grief.
replacements.alt: Symbolic artwork of Jesus Christ sitting quietly with grieving parents

replacements.name: child-loss-resurrection-dawn
replacements.title: Return to resurrection hope when ready
replacements.description: Light enters an empty tomb, holding space for sorrow while pointing toward resurrection through Jesus Christ.
replacements.alt: An illustrative empty rock-cut tomb beyond wildflowers in morning light

replacements.name: conference-study-prayer
replacements.title: Bring your study into prayer
replacements.description: The scene shows prayer after study. After reading the message, you might name one gratitude, need, or question as a personal response.
replacements.alt: A woman pausing in prayer after study at her dining table

replacements.name: god-learn-prayer
replacements.title: Learn prayer from Jesus
replacements.description: A devotional portrayal of Jesus in prayer, beside His teaching about prayer to the Father. The image depicts Jesus Christ, not Heavenly Father.
replacements.alt: Jesus Christ looking upward in quiet prayer

replacements.name: grief-hope-open-tomb
replacements.title: Hold sorrow and resurrection hope together
replacements.description: Light reaches into an empty tomb, holding sorrow and resurrection hope in the same view. Return to the linked conversation between Jesus and Martha as you continue the study.
replacements.alt: An illustrative empty burial chamber with daylight entering its open doorway

replacements.name: grief-memory-notebook
replacements.title: Leave room for a memory or question
replacements.description: A contemporary reflection scene. You can pause with the passage, write a memory, or simply name the comfort you need today.
replacements.alt: An older man pausing beside a notebook and a family photograph

replacements.name: grief-savior-compassion
replacements.title: The Savior’s compassion in sorrow
replacements.description: The Savior offers quiet compassion in a moment of sorrow, inviting reflection on the comfort and hope offered through Christ.
replacements.alt: Symbolic artwork of Jesus Christ accompanying a grieving woman on a garden path

replacements.name: grief-welcome-care
replacements.title: Offer a form of care that is welcome
replacements.description: The scene shows care guided by the person receiving it. The covenant passage invites people to mourn with and comfort others; ask what would be helpful.
replacements.alt: A friend arranging flowers where a grieving woman welcomes them

replacements.name: joseph-inquiry-prayer
replacements.title: Approach an inquiry prayerfully
replacements.description: A man bows his head beside a closed book on a quiet park bench, giving prayer and careful study room to work together as he seeks understanding.
replacements.alt: A man pausing in prayer beside a closed book in a quiet park

replacements.name: joseph-printing-work
replacements.title: Consider the work of publishing a book
replacements.description: Two printers set type and prepare pages by hand, reflecting the skilled labor required to publish the Book of Mormon. Follow the linked introduction into reliable accounts of its publication.
replacements.alt: An interpretive scene of early nineteenth-century printers preparing type and paper

replacements.name: joseph-shared-reading
replacements.title: Follow the shared work through the text
replacements.description: Two readers compare a passage with their notes, keeping the source beside the question they are investigating.
replacements.alt: Two readers comparing a passage with their notes

replacements.name: look-christ-invitation
replacements.title: Turn attention toward Christ
replacements.description: A devotional image of Christ accompanying the invitation to look to Him. Read that invitation beside the surrounding encouragement to faithful action and remembrance.
replacements.alt: Jesus Christ facing the viewer with a calm attentive expression

replacements.name: restoration-christ-center
replacements.title: Keep Jesus Christ at the center
replacements.description: Jesus Christ teaches attentive disciples, directing the eye toward the Savior as the cornerstone of a united covenant community.
replacements.alt: Jesus Christ teaching attentive disciples

replacements.name: restoration-gospel-teaching
replacements.title: Examine the gospel Christ describes
replacements.description: Jesus Christ teaches a listening disciple, inviting attention to the gospel He describes and the life that teaching asks us to live.
replacements.alt: Jesus Christ explaining a teaching to a listener

replacements.name: restoration-read-original
replacements.title: Read belief and order in the original text
replacements.description: An open book, paper and inkwell evoke the work of preserving belief and order in written form. Read the linked text for its account of scripture and the organization of the Church.
replacements.alt: A writing table with an open book, blank paper and an inkwell

replacements.name: restoration-shared-questions
replacements.title: Study a claim together
replacements.description: Three friends gather around a source, listening carefully and giving each person room for a sincere question about belief or discipleship.
replacements.alt: Three friends comparing a source and listening to a question in a library

replacements.name: stand-prayerful-question
replacements.title: Carry the question prayerfully
replacements.description: The scene shows seeking God while giving a question thoughtful care. Read the passage and consider what you wish to ask with sincerity.
replacements.alt: A woman pausing in prayer beside an open book on a balcony

replacements.name: temple-generations-craft
replacements.title: Temple building across generations
replacements.description: Craftsmen shape and assemble materials with patience, reflecting the devoted work of preparing a place of worship.
replacements.alt: Two stonemasons measuring a carved building stone

replacements.name: jesus-prayer-solitude-v2
replacements.title: Notice His pattern of prayer
replacements.description: This devotional interpretation accompanies Luke’s account of Jesus withdrawing to pray. Consider how making room for prayer could shape a day of following Him.
replacements.alt: Jesus Christ in a muted aubergine robe praying quietly beside an olive tree

replacements.name: jesus-compassion-attention-v4
replacements.title: Make room for another person
replacements.description: Jesus Christ listens attentively to an older man, showing how compassionate presence can honor another person. Read how the Savior made time for people, then consider who might welcome your attention.
replacements.alt: Jesus Christ listening attentively to an elderly man in a courtyard
